1.name: Foundation & Data Readiness
goals: Confirm data sources and access
Provision the minimum compute footprint
Validate the security profile

1.name: Pilot Build & Validation
goals: Implement the pipeline against a representative sample
Validate output quality against a labeled set

1.name: Production Rollout
goals: Scale to full data volume
Stand up monitoring for output drift

2.name: Foundation & Knowledge Ingestion
goals: Index the target document corpus
Confirm access controls and data classification

2.name: Pilot Build & Retrieval Tuning
goals: Build the retrieval + generation pipeline
Tune retrieval precision against representative questions

2.name: Production Rollout
goals: Roll out to the target user group
Establish a source re-indexing cadence

3.name: Foundation & Integration Design
goals: Confirm host-application integration points
Provision low-latency serving infrastructure

3.name: Pilot Build
goals: Build the sidecar/copilot experience
Tune latency against the target SLA
deliverables: Working pilot integrated into the host application

3.name: UX Validation
goals: Validate suggestions with real end users
Refine tone and format based on feedback

3.name: Production Rollout
goals: Roll out to the full user base
Monitor adoption and suggestion acceptance rate

4.name: Foundation & Checkpoint Design
goals: Map the multi-step workflow and system integrations
Define human-approval checkpoints

4.name: Pilot Build
goals: Build the agent and its tool integrations
Implement approval checkpoints end-to-end

4.name: Governance Review
goals: Review agent permissions and action scope with governance stakeholders
Confirm escalation paths

4.name: Production Rollout
goals: Roll out to the target team
Monitor checkpoint approval rates and exceptions

5.name: Foundation & Multi-Agent Design
goals: Define each sub-agent's scope and credentials
Design the orchestration logic

5.name: Pilot Build
goals: Build each sub-agent and the orchestrator
Implement per-agent credential scoping

5.name: Autonomous Safety Validation
goals: Test the system against edge cases and failure modes
Validate the kill-switch and rollback path

5.name: Governance Review
goals: Present the autonomy boundary and safety validation to the governance board
Confirm the staged rollout plan

5.name: Staged Production Rollout
goals: Roll out behind a capped blast radius
Progressively expand scope as confidence grows

assist.title: Human-reviewed output only
assist.rationale: Assist-level automation produces advisory output only; standard review before use is sufficient governance.

copilot.title: Approval checkpoint before external action
copilot.rationale: Copilot-level automation can draft or suggest actions a human still executes; document who holds final approval before anything reaches a customer or system of record.

autonomous.title: Mandatory kill-switch and audit logging
autonomous.rationale: Autonomous automation acts without per-action human approval; every action must be logged for post-hoc audit, and an operator-accessible kill-switch is required.

autonomous.title: Staged autonomy rollout with a capped blast radius
autonomous.rationale: Roll out autonomous decisioning behind a capped threshold (dollar amount, record volume, etc.) before removing the cap, consistent with comparable implementations in the Solution Registry.

pilot.title: Lightweight governance for pilot scope
pilot.rationale: A pilot's limited blast radius means governance can start lightweight — standard audit logging is sufficient until scale increases.

department.title: Departmental data-access review
department.rationale: A department-wide rollout should have its data-access scope reviewed by the data owner before go-live.

enterprise.title: Governance board sign-off required
enterprise.rationale: Enterprise-scale deployments should be reviewed by the AI governance board before rollout, given the broader organizational exposure.
